title: Comment on PR-026 "End-of-page menu clock rolls like the top clock: about 27x…": give me iphone now.

anchor.label: End-of-page menu clock rolls like the top clock: about 27x less script; small Safari difference only mid-roll

messages.text:
The phone isn't free yet. The menu clock Try-it pages are ready and waiting for you.
- int-v8 started a timed phone test for the next build (v9.2) at 20:58Z. It takes up to 15 minutes.
- Touching the phone now would spoil that test, so I've asked the lead to hand you the phone now or as soon as the test ends.
- When you have it, open PR-026 on the Proposals page and use its phone links: A is today's page, B is the new menu clock.
- Scroll to the bottom so the menu is open, then watch the menu clock for a few seconds on each.
What you need to do: wait for the lead's go, then open the two phone links.

Yes: I'm pausing the v9.2 phone test now, so the iPhone is yours in about a minute.
- I'll reply here as soon as it is free; nothing runs on it while you try the menu clock proposal (PR-026).
- Then open PR-026 on the Proposals page and use its two phone links: A is today's page, B is the new menu clock.
- The paused test restarts after you are done; nothing counted is lost.
What you need to do: wait for my "free" message here, then open the two phone links. Tell me here when you are done.

I've asked for the phone to be freed now.
- int-v8, which holds the phone, has your request to stop its test and give the phone back.
- The lead has it too and can release the phone directly.
- You'll see a note here when the phone is free.
What you need to do: when the note says the phone is free, open PR-026's two phone links.

The iPhone is free now and held for you; no test will start on it until you say you are done.
- Open the menu clock proposal (PR-026) on the Proposals page and use its two phone links: A is today's page, B is the new menu clock.
- Scroll to the bottom so the menu is open, then watch the menu clock for a few seconds on each.
What you need to do: try A and B now, then pick on the proposal or tell me here "done".

Thanks, noted. I've told the lead the phone can go back to the other tests.
What you need to do: on the PR-026 proposal, pick accept, reject or change, with a note on what you saw if you like.

Thanks: I released the iPhone and the paused v9.2 phone test restarts now (about 70 min of robot-finger runs).
- If the heat setting is off, a console step asks you to press Start on "Serious" in Xcode's Device Conditions on the Mac.
- Your pick on the menu clock proposal (PR-026) can come any time; it does not need the phone.
What you need to do: leave the iPhone plugged in and unlocked, and don't touch it while the test runs.
